About Me

Langley

Cinematic Video Editor

I believe that every frame has a pulse. My work isn't just about cutting footage; it's about finding the hidden rhythm in the chaos and sculpting it into a narrative that breathes.

With over 5 years of experience in post-production, I specialize in pacing, sound design, and color grading that elevates raw footage into emotional experiences. Whether it's a high-energy music video or a nuanced commercial, I edit with intention.
